items.title: Anduril Deputy Head of Production, Altius (applied 10-19): Writer refuses to record it because a rejected row matches
items.detail: Anduril confirmed your new application 2026-10-19 17:22 ET (Gmail 1a1560b17e0a7ce0). Writer holds it twice (even with force:true) because it matches a REJECTED_BY_EMPLOYER row. The 10-16 rejection email (Gmail 1a1466cc749e6241) names Deputy Head of Production, Connected Warfare, a different role; an Aug 25 Altius application was rejected ~Aug 28 per the sender's notes. Greenhouse job 5220654007. The gofer does not send a third identical request.
items.blocks: Application record for the 10-19 Altius application (not in master/index).
options: Writer owner: add a supported way to record a re-application over REJECTED_BY_EMPLOYER (honor force with new-application evidence)
Record as a new protected ANTI_RESURRECTION row instead
items.recommended: First option; evidence is a dated employer confirmation after the rejection.

items.title: Trim the WEB_CAREER_DISCOVERY lane once automatic intake is reliable?
items.detail: The source-trial Action already reads ~160 employer job boards every run. Grok's WEB_CAREER_DISCOVERY lane searches many of the same career sites. Once automatic intake (armed 2026-10-23) has run cleanly for a few days, the lane could be cut down to the priority companies the Action finds no board for (Tesla, Anduril, LeoLabs and others in the source-trial report).
items.blocks: Lower AI cost per run; nothing is blocked today.
items.recommended: Trim, but only after about a week of clean automatic intake runs.
items.action: Answer in chat; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.

items.title: Pay for a proxy so JobSpy can read ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor?
items.detail: On GitHub's servers ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor block every JobSpy search (403) and Google returns nothing; LinkedIn is partly rate-limited (429). Fixing it needs a paid residential proxy. Until then the ChatGPT ZIPRECRUITER_WEEKLY lane is the only ZipRecruiter coverage and must stay.
options: Buy a proxy and then retire the lane
items.recommended: Keep the lane; a proxy costs money every month for one source.
items.action: Answer in chat; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
